title: CFO in judicial recovery: 5 steps to save your company
excerpt: In 2023, 52,000 French companies were placed in judicial recovery. Discover how a part-time CFO can transform this critical situation into a recovery opportunity.
content:
In 2023, 52,000 French companies were placed in judicial recovery according to INSEE, an increase of 15% compared to 2022. Faced with this reality, the CFO's role becomes crucial to transform a critical situation into a recovery opportunity.

**1. Express financial diagnosis (24-48h)**
The first challenge is to establish a precise assessment. An experienced CFO can identify hidden cash flow levers and assess the feasibility of the continuation plan. Companies that act within 48h have 3x more chances of survival.

**2. Debt restructuring**
Negotiating with creditors requires sharp technical expertise. A part-time CFO brings the necessary credibility to obtain payment delays and debt write-offs. On average, 40% of debts can be restructured.

**3. Operational optimization**
Cost reduction must be surgical. An experienced CFO identifies non-essential positions while preserving productive capacity. The goal: reduce costs by 20-30% without impacting quality.

**4. Transparent communication**
Transparency with stakeholders is crucial. A part-time CFO establishes rigorous reporting that reassures creditors and maintains team confidence.

**5. Crisis exit plan**
The final objective is to regain financial balance. A part-time CFO develops a recovery plan over 12-18 months with measurable milestones.

**The impact of a part-time CFO**
Companies accompanied by a part-time CFO in judicial recovery see their survival rate increase from 60% to 85%. Investment in a part-time CFO often proves profitable from the first month.

If your company is going through a difficult period, don't wait. A part-time CFO can make the difference between survival and liquidation. Contact us for an emergency intervention.

Without financial expertise, startups make costly mistakes: poor cash management, erroneous forecasts, poorly prepared fundraising. On average, these mistakes cost €150,000 per year to a 20-employee startup.

**The benefits of a part-time CFO**
A part-time CFO brings the expertise of an experienced financial director at a controlled cost. They establish rigorous management processes, prepare fundraising and optimize cash management. Startups accompanied by a part-time CFO raise 40% more funds on average.

A part-time CFO implements real-time cash dashboards. They anticipate financing needs and optimize inventory turnover. Result: a 30% reduction in working capital requirements.

**Fundraising preparation**
Investors require total financial transparency. A part-time CFO prepares financial documents, establishes forecasts and negotiates terms. Well-prepared startups obtain 25% higher valuations.

**Operational management**
A part-time CFO establishes relevant financial KPIs and implements monthly reporting. They identify profitability levers and optimize cost structure. Startups managed by a part-time CFO see their gross margin increase by 15% on average.

**Strategic support**
Beyond financial management, a part-time CFO participates in strategic decisions. They evaluate project profitability, analyze acquisition opportunities and advise on capital structure.

Investment in a part-time CFO proves profitable from the first month. On average, startups recover 5x their investment through financial optimization and easier access to financing.
